metadata.source: Powercor 2026-27 Pricing (structure) + Powercor 2026-27 Tariff Summary (final, 7 May 2026; rates)
metadata.notes: Excluding GST. Residential ToU PRSTOU: peak 4pm-9pm, saver 11am-4pm, off-peak 9pm-11am, all days, rates from the Powercor 2026-27 Tariff Summary (final, 7 May 2026; knowledge/documents/powercor/2026-11-10-tariff-summary-2026-27). Small business ToU peak is 9am-9pm workdays. Residential/export CER tariffs and all demand-charge tariffs (NDD/NDM/NDMO/large/HV/sub-transmission) are NOT seeded -- same reasoning as citipower.json (single-window demand schema can't represent the two-season summer/non-summer demand charge without an unmade modeling decision). Source PDF gives tariff codes/structure but not $ rates -- those live in the Powercor 2026-27 Tariff Summary (final, 7 May 2026), which gives the rates of every seeded tariff here (D1, DD1, PRSTOU, ND1, NDTOU); the rows other than residential ToU are recorded in knowledge/findings/2026-11-10-victorian-2026-27-non-tou-network-rates (#73). The AER TSS.01 indicative-prices spreadsheet (Jan2025 proposal) is no longer a rate source for any seeded tariff. Powercor and CitiPower are commonly-owned/co-filed (same tariff structure text verbatim, confirmed by direct comparison) -- data independently sourced and verified per-DNSP, not copied across.
